story.title: Selma Blair Arrested Following Alleged Altercation on Delta Flight
story.summary: Selma Blair was arrested after an incident on a Delta flight from Los Angeles to New York City. Reports indicate she allegedly bit a flight attendant and attempted to open the plane's door, leading to her being restrained. Authorities stated that she was physically abusive and injured two flight attendants during the altercation. Following the incident, she was taken to a hospital for evaluation.

explore_lenses.label: Why is an in-flight assault treated seriously?
explore_lenses.title: Crew interference can trigger separate legal tracks
explore_lenses.summary: The reported conduct matters beyond a routine passenger dispute because injuries to crew and interference with their duties can prompt airport-police action, a federal investigation, and aviation enforcement.

claims.text: Port Authority Police said two flight attendants reported injuries; CBS News, citing a law-enforcement source, reported one bite injury and one laceration.

Federal law makes it a crime to assault or intimidate a flight attendant in a way that interferes with, or reduces the attendant's ability to perform, duties; the maximum statutory penalty is 20 years' imprisonment absent a dangerous weapon.
The FAA says it may investigate airline-reported unruly-passenger incidents and propose civil penalties of up to $43,658 per violation, while serious cases can be referred for criminal prosecution.
Delta said it has “zero tolerance for unruly or unlawful behavior,” framing the incident as a crew-and-passenger safety issue.

story_report.summary: Selma Blair was arrested after an alleged altercation aboard a Delta flight from Los Angeles to New York City. Authorities said she was physically abusive and that two flight attendants were injured; reports alleged that she bit a crew member and tried to open the aircraft door. After the plane landed, police took Blair to Jamaica Hospital for evaluation. Her representative said she had experienced a medical emergency and was stable after receiving medical attention.

sections.heading: Flight Incident Carries Multiple Legal Paths
sections.body: CBS News reported that the FBI was examining a potential assault on the aircraft and that Blair received a federal summons related to alleged assaults within the special aircraft jurisdiction of the United States. Separately, CBS reported she was transferred to Queens Central Booking for arraignment on two state assault counts tied to alleged conduct in an ambulance and hospital. The FAA may investigate airline-reported unruly-passenger incidents and propose civil penalties, while criminal cases are handled separately.

sections.heading: Selma Blair Representative Cites Medical Emergency
sections.body: Blair's representative told ABC News that a medical emergency led to the alleged conduct, but Blair's attorney did not specify the nature of that emergency, CBS News reported. A hospital evaluation does not by itself establish a diagnosis, causation or a legal defense. No public medical documentation, toxicology information or official finding has explained Blair's condition or addressed legal responsibility.

related_stories.title: New York City Police Use-of-Force Review Ordered by Mayor Mamdani
related_stories.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani has ordered a review of the New York Police Department's use-of-force policies, marking the first such review in a decade. This decision comes amid calls for greater police reform, although city officials state that it is not directly related to a recent police response to an ICE shooting. The review aims to address concerns raised by progressive advocates regarding police practices.

related_stories.title: Evacuations Ordered in Nepal Following Budhi Gandaki Flash Flood
related_stories.summary: Nepal's authorities have ordered evacuations for residents along the Budhi Gandaki River after a landslide triggered a flash flood on October 11. The flood has swept away homes and buildings in the mountainous north-central region of the country.

related_stories.title: Hurricane Simon Strikes Mexico's Pacific Coast, Causing Flooding and Damage
related_stories.summary: Hurricane Simon has weakened to a Category 3 storm but continues to impact Mexico's Pacific coast with strong winds and heavy rainfall. The storm has caused significant flooding in homes and has affected resorts and vulnerable towns along the coastline.
